content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DMHO Jangaon Ophthalmic Assistant/Optometrist Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website:jangaon.telangana.gov.in/ . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 25-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DMHO Jangaon Ophthalmic Assistant/Optometrist recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DMHO Jangaon Ophthalmic Assistant/Optometrist posts is 25th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Ophthalmic Assistant/Optometrist post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Ophthalmic Assistant/Optometrist post in the District Medical and Health Office Jangaon.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Ophthalmic Assistant/Optometrist position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Ophthalmic Assistant/Optometrist position is Rs. 1000 Per Day.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications required for the Ophthalmic Assistant/Optometrist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed SSC or Equivalent, Intermediate or 10+2, and possess a Qualifying Examination Pass Certificate (Ophthalmic Assistant/Optometrist) along with registration from the Medical Council.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the DMHO Jangaon Ophthalmic Assistant/Optometrist recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Exam followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. When is the written exam scheduled?
faq.answer: The written exam is scheduled to be conducted on 27th September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article, under the "Official Notification PDF" link.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates as mentioned in the official notification.
